actions.name: AMoveGroup
actions.description: Attack-move to a position or attack a unit.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: target
params.description: Target position or unit ID.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: SC2 tags derived from group.

actions.name: GroupUseAbility
actions.description: Issue the same ability to the group.

params.name: ability
params.description: Ability to use.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: target
params.description: Target position, unit ID, or explicit null.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: SC2 tags derived from group.

params.name: sync_command
params.description: Require all units ready; otherwise require any. Commands reach the whole group. Default: true.

actions.name: KeepGroupSafe
actions.description: Move units to safety, optionally attacking enemies in range.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: close_enemy
params.description: Visible enemy IDs eligible for attacks; may be empty.

params.name: grid
params.description: Ground or air influence grid for the group.

params.name: attack_in_range_enemy
params.description: Attack enemies in range when weapons are ready. Default: true.

actions.name: PathGroupToTarget
actions.description: Move the group along a path toward the target.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: target
params.description: Destination coordinates.

params.name: start
params.description: Current group center.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: SC2 tags derived from group.

params.name: grid
params.description: Ground or air influence grid for the group.

params.name: distance_check_squared
params.description: Squared distance threshold for duplicate orders. Default: 26.25.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: Stop issuing moves within this distance. Default: 0.0.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: Pathfinding sensitivity. Default: 12.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Smooth the path. Default: false.

params.name: sense_danger
params.description: Enable danger-aware path queries. Default: false.

params.name: danger_distance
params.description: Danger detection distance. Default: 20.0.

params.name: danger_threshold
params.description: Danger influence threshold. Default: 5.0.

params.name: prevent_duplicate
params.description: Suppress duplicate or similar moves. Default: true.

actions.name: StutterGroupBack
actions.description: Attack toward the target position and retreat from danger during weapon cooldown.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: target
params.description: Target position or unit ID.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: SC2 tags derived from group.

params.name: group_position
params.description: Current group center.

params.name: grid
params.description: Ground or air influence grid for the group.

actions.name: StutterGroupForward
actions.description: Alternate movement and attacks toward the enemy group center.

params.name: group
params.description: Non-empty list of own unit IDs.

params.name: enemies
params.description: Visible enemy IDs to advance toward; empty means no action.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: SC2 tags derived from group.

params.name: group_position
params.description: Current group center.

params.name: target
params.description: Center of the selected enemies, used as a reference target.
